result.passAtK: Percentage of items where at least one of the 3 runs achieved a perfect score (100%).
result.passHatK: Percentage of items where all 3 runs achieved a perfect score (100%).
result.maxAtK: Average of the best score across all 3 runs for each item.
result.consistency: Measures how often runs agree on pass/fail across 3 runs. 100% = all runs agree, 0% = 50/50 split.
result.reliability: When an item CAN be solved, how often is it? Only includes items with at least one passing run.
result.failedCount: Number of runs that threw an error (across all items). Errors are scored as 0%.
result.avgScore: The mean score across all items and all runs.
result.avgLatency: The mean response time across all items and all runs.
result.medianLatency: The median response time across all items and all runs. Less sensitive to outliers than the mean.
